run_rank_features: run feature ranking using FAISS nearest neighbor distance on extracted features
build_feature_index: build a FAISS L2 index on normalized features for nearest neighbor search
rank_features_by_distance: rank features by sorting images based on nearest neighbor L2 distance
apply_pca_to_features: apply PCA dimensionality reduction to features before ranking
extract_and_rank_features: extract features from a dataset and rank them by nearest neighbor distance
